statements.proposition: This change adds an `enable_prompt_caching: bool = False` parameter to the LLM class, so prompt caching is off by default.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Parameter and default confirmed in the diff; the 'for backward compatibility' rationale is not judged here.
evidence: llm.py patch adds '+        enable_prompt_caching: bool = False,' to LLM.__init__ and '+        self.enable_prompt_caching = enable_prompt_caching'
llm.py patch: caching is applied only under 'if self.enable_prompt_caching and self._supports_prompt_caching():' in _format_messages_for_provider

statements.proposition: With the new feature disabled by default, existing code continues to work unchanged (no behaviour change for existing users).
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The caching code itself is gated, but the same change alters default-path behaviour. _is_anthropic_model now returns False for any model containing 'bedrock/' (previously 'bedrock/anthropic.claude-...' matched 'claude-' and returned True), so the Anthropic placeholder-user-message logic in _format_messages_for_provider no longer runs for Bedrock Claude models even with caching off. Streaming tool-call events also now emit a converted ToolCall object instead of tool_call.to_dict(), and several 'assert hasattr(crewai_event_bus, "emit")' became silent 'if' guards. Not run end to end; settled by reading the diff.
